purpose: Exploratory author-train incremental frozen-audio comparison with unseen speakers and canonical target words
split: Reuse fold_split from speechocean_r_speaker_word_purged: same five speaker holdouts, remove fit clips sharing exact heldout canonical target words, choose inner validation speakers from retained outer fit, then remove inner-fit clips sharing inner-validation words
head: Three-class linear softmax on fit-standardized columns with fit-only word vocabulary, L2 weight penalty, unpenalized intercept, and five-rating class distribution
selectionMetric: Lowest inner speaker-and-word-disjoint per-rater natural-log loss; smallest L2 breaks ties
brierDefinition: Mean across five raters of summed squared probability error over three one-hot classes
comparison: Combined minus capture-only log loss and Brier on identical 766 heldout clips; negative favors combined, without implying an encoder winner
